verdict.rationale: Docs show the underlying calculation inputs — nexus-based rate determination, product category/subcategory taxability, and address validation (kintsugi-docs-31, kintsugi-docs-33, kintsugi-docs-36) — and confirm transaction sync creates a 'permanent record' (kintsugi-docs-19) with filings retrievable via API (kintsugi-docs-13). However, there is no documented per-transaction audit report or endpoint that surfaces the specific rate/rule/address-resolution breakdown that produced a given transaction's tax, nor an explicit 'export for audit' feature. Missing for 10: a documented per-transaction calculation detail/audit endpoint, explicit exportable audit trail, and evidence tying product category + address resolution + rules back to an individual retained transaction record.
